summary: fractal-test (scripts/st-test) fetches the base again, up to 3 times with a short backoff, when git refuses because another fetch in the same shared clone moved origin/main at that moment ('cannot lock ref'), instead of ending a run that has already waited for a pool tree

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: What is signed and how the gate judges it are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only the 'cannot lock ref' fetch error is retried; every other fetch error fails at once as before. st-test re-executes the base's copy, so this applies to every branch once it merges.
